claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.wearing_item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The passive benefits apply only while the cloak is worn, but the current surface has no generic worn-item gate for magic-item mechanics.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "While wearing it, you gain the following benefits."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.granted_spell_override.area_multiplier
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item grants an existing spell but changes one printed mechanical parameter: the size of the created web area.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "The web created by the spell fills twice its normal area."
